substitutions.notes: Starter plan limits: 1 variable mode and 3 pages per file. Light/dark is therefore implemented as two collections (Color, Color Dark) with identical variable names rather than two modes in one collection. Pages are 3 with sections/frames inside. v1 is light-mode and compact-only; Color Dark and expanded breakpoints are deferred.

Design file sf2EOTYc8LBadE7LpIu8kR and FigJam board 2O145eRxj0Ta11iwIMwuEH created on plan team::1556872439110631612; session 3c99d509-1931-4c41-9308-5a8c0f15db0f.

P1: 3 pages, 36 color variables in Color (Light) + 36 in Color Dark, 13 float variables (space/radius/size), 13 text styles, 3 effect styles. Plus Jakarta Sans confirmed available (Regular/Medium/SemiBold/Bold/ExtraBold).
P2 pilot: Button set (4 variants x 4 states, node 4:34) and Card set (2x3, node 4:53). Variants laid out in grids after combineAsVariants. Visual QA passed on a 460x264 render.

Brand system v1: BRAND.md, Ledger E mark, app icon + adaptive foreground, 9 ledger-line illustrations. Imported into Figma and composed as Brand — Board v1 (node 8:82). 9 illustrations under 160x160, exported from SVG sources in docs/brand/source/.

Built Input (16) 12:94 and AppBar (8) 12:135 plus 18 icon components. Font-codepoint glyphs were wrong (Figma Material Icons release differs from Flutter's). Uploaded 18 official Material Symbols SVGs as loose frames. The fix call (docs/figma/build/p2-icons-fix.js) was blocked by the Starter MCP quota before executing. See RESUME.md.

Confirmed the Starter quota still blocks use_figma (whoami: Starter/View). Evaluated the REST API and rejected it for building: read-only apart from comments, variables and dev resources. Adopted a local development plugin at docs/figma/plugin/ (flat code.js, no UI, no bundler) which runs the same Plugin API code unmetered; figma-linux supports development-plugin import. User installs it once; P2a fix is the first batch.

Local plugin run. P2a: 18 icons replaced, Input 1352x296, AppBar 1632x136. P2b: Snackbar (3), Dialog (2), BottomSheet (4), token-bound to space/* and radius/* floats and linked to Type/* text styles. New sets are top-level on page 01 below AppBar (no S · Components section exists); locate by name. Plugin API constraints recorded in plugin/README.md.

Atoms: PriceText 6, StatusBadge 20, Skeleton 8, EmptyState 2, AsyncValue 3, MonogramImage 4. Cards: KhqrCard 3, OrderStatusTimeline 6, OrderTrackingCard 6, ProductCard 48 (full cartesian product). Geometry taken from the widget sources where components.json was silent. 17 of 18 real sets done; NavigationBar remains. Plugin sources split into src/*.js with build.js assembling the flat code.js.

NavigationBar (8 tab items: Role x State x CartBadge) completes the 18 component sets. Six extra Material Symbols (home, explore, receipt_long, dashboard, inventory_2, bar_chart) were created in-plugin with figma.createNodeFromSvg from inlined path data, so no upload call was needed. Next: 30 screens on page 02.

All 30 compact screens on page 02: 15 pixel (component instances, real copy) in S · Customer and S · Admin, plus 15 wireframes driven from screens.json sections. Screens are the canonical loaded state per screen; the per-state variants listed in screens.json (about 90) remain a separate pass.

All 9 diagrams drawn on the FigJam board by a separate dev plugin (docs/figma/plugin-figjam/, editorType figjam): navigation, order lifecycle, payment lifecycle, auth/checkout/KHQR sequences, ERD (22 entities, 23 relations), permission matrix, state ownership. Panels are titled backdrops rather than FigJam sections so each exports self-describing; connectors proved supported.

Frozen as a snapshot, not a live mirror: code + docs/architecture-contract.md are authoritative and this file is a projection pinned to specCommit 81dc7a7 / builtAtCommit 92ec37c. Decisions recorded in HANDOFF-FIGMA.md §1: no per-state screens (~90 declined), no Code Connect, no dark-mode or expanded-breakpoint variants, demo visuals captured from the running app instead of the board. Canvas state: 18 component sets (Button 16, Card 6, Input 16, AppBar 8, Snackbar 3, Dialog 2, BottomSheet 4, PriceText 6, StatusBadge 20, Skeleton 8, EmptyState 2, AsyncValue 3, MonogramImage 4, NavigationBar 8, KhqrCard 3, OrderStatusTimeline 6, OrderTrackingCard 6, ProductCard 48), 24 Icon/* components, 30 screens on page 02, page 03 motion/contracts, 9 FigJam diagrams. Rebuilt 2026-11-08 after the auto-layout hug fix and the wire-widget rewrite; three defects the rebuild exposed (cancelled tracking card, unsaved heart fill, page-03 heading accumulation) fixed in 92ec37c. Accepted defects: screens are region-accurate but widget-incomplete (screen content came from screens.json summaries, no *_screen.dart was read); measured overflow is recorded in notes.audit; the timeline component cannot represent Delivered; FigJam nav map and ERD gaps stand. No further build events are appended to this manifest — future UI belongs in the app and the contract.
